summary: Deprovision nodes or instance groups by adding `node_state=deprovision` to a host or a group's `:vars` and rerunning the installer, which removes their configuration and logs; the first `[automationcontroller]` host can't be deprovisioned.
questions: How do I remove a node from AAP?
How do I deprovision an instance group?

answer_card.title: Deprovision a node or instance group
answer_card.answer_md:
```ini
[automationcontroller]
host1.example.com
host2.example.com
host4.example.com   node_state=deprovision

[instance_group_restrictedzone:vars]
node_state=deprovision
```
Then rerun the installer. The first host in `[automationcontroller]` cannot be deprovisioned.
